answer: Proposal: burn-capped subsidies. A key burns deposit D before drawing pool rewards; the ledger caps lifetime payout at D via on-chain mint checks — auditable, no issuer needed. n clones burn nD and extract ≤ nD: net ≤ 0 minus fees, cost and reward on the same lifetime horizon. A plume of identities brings no net gain; no key gets tenure like an old cedar, the cap binds seniors too. Burn must be irreversible, else a refundable bond makes farming free. Honest keys also sink D, so the pool deters sybils without enriching anyone; direct client payments stay uncapped.
